home: Welcome to the Goat Care App
tempOutsideRangeWarning: Temperature is Outside of Normal Range
pleaseCompleteChecklist: ⚠️ Please complete all tasks in the checklist before submitting.
confirmGoatATemp: ⚠️ Please confirm Goat A's temperature is outside the normal range before submitting.
confirmGoatBTemp: ⚠️ Please confirm Goat B's temperature is outside the normal range before submitting.
submissionError: Error submitting report. Check the console for details.
bodyTempDesc: The normal body temperature range for goats is 38.5°C～40.5°C
holdGoatSecurely: Hold the goat securely and insert it carefully
cleanThermometerAfterUse: Wash the thermometer thoroughly after use
stoolConditionDesc: Changes in stool condition can help detect issues early
normalStool: Normal: Hard pellets similar to coffee beans
softStool: Soft: Solid pellets or soft consistency
appetiteDesc: Changes in appetite can be an early indicator of health problems
goodAppetite: Good: Eating actively and finishing all food
poorAppetite: Bad: Reluctant to eat, leaves food behind
noFoodFor24h: Complete refusal to eat food for more than 24 hours requires (veterinary attention)
callAVetIf: Contact a veterinarian immediately if you observe any of the following:
abnormalDischarge: Abnormal discharge from the eyes, nose, or mouth
waterChangeDesc: Make sure the goats always have access to clean, fresh water
emptyAndRinseBucket: Empty the bucket and rinse thoroughly
secureBucketProperly: Ensure the bucket is securely fastened and does not tip over
shelterCleaningDesc: Keeping the shelter clean helps prevent disease and keeps goats comfortable
checkForRepairs: Check for areas that need repair
electricFenceDesc: Remember to turn on the electric fence to keep goats contained and safe
ensureFencePowerOn: Make sure the fence is turned on
inspectForDamage: check the fence for damage or breakage
removeVegetationTouchingFence: Remove any vegatation touching the fence
checkIndicatorLight: Check that indicator lights are working properly
checkVoltage: ⚡︎ Check the voltage of the fence ⚡︎
